These sacred feathered serpents tirelessly serve the powers of knowledge and justice. Some operate directly as messengers and intermediaries of the deities, while others operate independently in aiding the cause of righteousness. Either way, they watch over mortals and try to influence and aid them from the shadows, shifting from plane to plane to spread wisdom and healing where they are needed. Some quetz coatls are worshipped as divinities in remote or isolated societies, and while they do not encourage such veneration, they use the trust placed in them to foster peace and cooperation with others. Quetz coatls are typically 10 to 20 feet long and weigh nearly a ton, with iridescent blue and green scales. Their glorious wings of rainbow-hued feathers span 15 feet. They are carnivorous, feeding on birds, mammals, and even the occasional malicious humanoid. **[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 29 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 27 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24 [Quetz Coatl](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2882) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 65 **Perception** +21; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115), [Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111), [Utopian](/Languages.aspx?ID=36); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +16, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +19, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +19, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +22, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +22, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +19, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +22, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +16 **Str** +7 **Dex** +3 **Con** +5 **Int** +6 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +5 --- **AC** 30 **Fort** +19 **Ref** +19 **Will** +21 **HP** 175 --- **Speed** 15 feet, fly 50 feet **Melee** jaws +23 ([Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)), **Damage** 2d10+13 piercing plus quetz coatl venom and [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Divine Innate Spells** DC 29 - **Cantrips (5th)** [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Telekinetic Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715), [Vitality Lash](/Spells.aspx?ID=1744) - **3rd** [Mind Reading](/Spells.aspx?ID=194) (at will) - **4th** [Charm](/Spells.aspx?ID=34), [Vapor Form](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738) - **5th** [Breath of Life](/Spells.aspx?ID=29), [Cleanse Affliction](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467), [Divine Wrath](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) - **7th** [Interplanar Teleport](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) (self only) **[Greater Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=65)** 2d10+7 bludgeoning, DC 29 **Quetz Coatl Venom** ([Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) To [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) creatures, this is a [curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=566) instead of a poison and deals spirit damage instead of poison damage; **Saving Throw** DC 29 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 2d6 poison damage and [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d8 poison damage, enfeebled 1, and [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d10 poison damage, enfeebled 2, and off-guard (1 round) **Radiant Wings** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93), [Light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The quetz coatl spreads their multicolored wings and radiant plumage. Each enemy in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 29 Will save.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Radiant Wings for 24 hours.
**Success** The creature is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** As failure, plus if the creature is [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), it is also [stunned 3](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93). **Wrap in Coils** **Requirements** The quetz coatl has a Medium or smaller creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) in its jaws; **Effect** The quetz coatl moves the creature into its coils, freeing its fangs to make attacks, then uses Greater Constrict against the creature. The quetz coatl can hold as many creatures in its coils as will fit in its space.
